item.name: Regions
item.description: Endpoints for sub-regions and areas (e.g. Jamaran, Azzurra, Old Town) belonging to a parent City (e.g. Sahl Hasheesh).

request.description: Returns all regions. Each region includes points [{latitude, longitude}], color (default #2D4F2E), center {latitude, longitude}, and boundaries (GeoJSON Polygon, set when points has at least 3 vertices). Optional: ?active=true|false

Returns the region plus its banners, chalets, advertisements, and categories. Advertisements include listings assigned to this region and listings whose latitude/longitude fall inside the region zone (when the zone has at least 3 points). Pass regionId as a query param.
Returns one region, including points, color, center, and boundaries.
Same payload as Get Region Data (by query param). Region id is in the path. Advertisements include listings inside the zone, not only listings whose region field matches.

item.name: Advertisements
item.description: Listings for the user: search, list, and open one advertisement. Filters can be used together or one at a time.

query.description: Optional. One category id, or several separated by commas. Matched listings must be in one of them.
Optional. Whole number. Listing capacity (guests_count, max_passengers, or passengers) must be at least this number.
Optional. One city id, or several separated by commas. A listing matches if it belongs to one of the cities or its coordinates fall inside that city zone.
Optional. One or more region ids, comma-separated. A listing matches if it belongs to one of the regions or its coordinates fall inside that region zone.
Optional, together with endDate. Start of the time window.
Optional, together with startDate. End of the time window.

Optional. How long the stay must fit inside the window, in the listing pricing unit (hours for per_hour, nights/days otherwise). If dates are sent without duration, the whole window must be free. If duration is sent without dates, listings whose minimum stay is longer than this value are excluded.
Optional text match on title, description, location, and address.
price_asc, price_desc, oldest, or newest (default).

item.name: 1. Create Booking [UNIVERSAL] (إنشاء حجز موحد لكافة الحالات)

request.description:
**ريكويست الحجز الموحد لتطبيق المستخدم (User Universal Booking):**

نفس هذا الريكويست `POST /api/v1/bookings` ينفذ الحجز لكافة الحالات في التطبيق:

---
### 1️⃣ حجز شاليه أو فيلا (Chalet / Villa):
```json
{
  "advertisement": "{{chaletId}}",
  "startDate": "2026-11-10T14:00:00.000Z",
  "endDate": "2026-11-13T12:00:00.000Z",
  "notes": "عائلات فقط"
}
```

---
### 2️⃣ حجز فندق وغرفة فندقية (Hotel & Room):
```json
{
  "advertisement": "{{hotelId}}",
  "room": "{{roomId}}",
  "startDate": "2026-11-01T14:00:00.000Z",
  "endDate": "2026-11-05T12:00:00.000Z",
  "guestDetails": {
    "adults": 2,
    "children": 1,
    "fullName": "أحمد زكي",
    "phone": "01012345678"
  }
}
```

---
### 3️⃣ حجز يخت بالساعة (Yacht - Hourly):
```json
{
  "advertisement": "{{yachtId}}",
  "rentalType": "hourly",
  "date": "2026-11-20",
  "startTime": "14:00",
  "durationHours": 3,
  "notes": "رحلة بحرية عائلية"
}
```

---
### 4️⃣ حجز يخت يوم كامل (Yacht - Full Day):
```json
{
  "advertisement": "{{yachtId}}",
  "rentalType": "full_day",
  "date": "2026-11-21"
}
```

---
### 5️⃣ حجز عربة جولف (Golf Car - Hourly or Daily):
* **بالساعة:**
```json
{
  "advertisement": "{{golfCarId}}",
  "rentalType": "hourly",
  "date": "2026-11-25",
  "startTime": "09:00",
  "durationHours": 2
}
```
* **باليوم الكامل:**
```json
{
  "advertisement": "{{golfCarId}}",
  "rentalType": "full_day",
  "date": "2026-11-26"
}
```
